parts.name: Root
parts.description: The tree container with the state. It has role="tree". It controls the focus, the expansion, the selection, and the actions of all of the items.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description:
The keys of the expanded nodes. By default it goes in the two directions: use
`bind:expandedKeys`.

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: The expanded keys at the start, for when you give no `expandedKeys`.

props.name: controlledExpandedKeys
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the expansion. The component stops to write back to
`expandedKeys`, and it reports only through `onExpandedKeysChange`. Thus the parent can refuse
a change: the parent does not send the new keys down. The default is off, because
`bind:expandedKeys` is the usual case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description:
The keys of the selected nodes. By default it goes in the two directions: use
`bind:selectedKeys`.

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The selected keys at the start, for when you give no `selectedKeys`.

props.name: controlledSelectedKeys
props.description: Give your own code full control of the selection. Read `controlledExpandedKeys`.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The ids of the items that obey `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The number of the items that the user can select: 'none', 'single', or 'multiple'.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: With 'toggle', an interaction adds an item to the selection or removes it. With 'replace', an interaction replaces the selection.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: With 'all', a disabled item does nothing. With 'selection', a disabled item keeps its focus and its actions, but the user cannot select it.

props.name: selectionPropagation
props.description: With 'none', the selection stays flat. With 'descendants', a selection goes down through the nodes below, and a parent with only some children selected becomes indeterminate.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Stops the user from the removal of the last selected item.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection, for a tree that the component makes from an array. Each entry goes to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: The static tree content. With `items`, it is a snippet, and the component calls it one time for each entry.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: The content while the tree has no items.

props.name: onExpandedKeysChange
props.description: The component calls it when the set of the expanded nodes changes.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: The component calls it when the selection changes.

props.name: onAction
props.description: The component calls it with the item id when the user activates an item with a click or with the `Enter` key.

props.name: itemTransition
props.description:
The enter transition and the exit transition of each item row, when a node expands or closes.
The default is none.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable object with the state of the tree, for a complex composition.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the tree element.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the tree has no items.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while a focus in the tree must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the tree.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the tree.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-mode
dataAttributes.description: The selection mode ('single' | 'multiple'). Absent when the selection is off.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-registration
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden container that registers the structure of the items. Do not write styles for it.

parts.name: Section
parts.description: Contains the top-level items that go together, below an optional header. It has role="group".

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the section node. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: value
props.description: Any data of the section.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection, for a tree that the component makes from an array. Each entry goes to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: The section header and the items. With `items`, it is a snippet, and the component calls it one time for each entry.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: The name of the items of a section.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the header.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One node of the tree. It makes the flat role="treeitem" row, and it shows the focus, hover, selection, and pressed states on that row.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id, in the sets of the expanded keys, the selected keys, and the disabled keys.

props.name: value
props.description: Any data of the item.

props.name: title
props.description: The title of the node, which a person reads. The component uses it as the text value.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Replaces the text that the typeahead compares.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item, and the `disabledBehavior` of the root sets the result.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the row (the trigger, the checkbox, and the label) and an optional `Tree.Children` part.

parts.name: Children
parts.description: Marks the nodes below an item. A parent with this part can expand from the first frame, and also on the server.

props.name: children
props.description: The `Tree.Item` nodes below this one.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The text of an item row. It also gives the row its name for assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the name.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the label element.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that expands and closes a node. It is in the DOM only when the item has nodes below it. The arrow keys do not move the focus to it.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the trigger, usually an icon for the expansion.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the branch is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed-when-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Always present. It marks a trigger whose pressed styles follow the expanded state.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the trigger element.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: The selection control of an item row. It stays correct with the selection of the tree, and also with an indeterminate parent.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the checkbox. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: title
props.description: The native tooltip text of the checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the checkbox, usually a `Tree.CheckboxIndicator`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name, for when the user sees no name.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the checkbox its name.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-checkbox
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the checkbox element.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: The mark in a tree checkbox. It is in the DOM while the checkbox is checked or indeterminate.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM, also while the checkbox is not checked.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the indicator, usually a check icon or a minus icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate, because only some nodes below it are selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-tree-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked (with `forceMount`).
